summary: Official Bangladesh DLRS survey/map services and Nazirhat municipal land-plot procedure evidence were found, but no anonymous Nazirhat parcel ID-plus-polygon response was verified. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Bangla discovery queries and actual result URLs are recorded in city-7548-nazirhat.json. First-party sources establish DLRS custody and public mouza-map workflows; they do not establish open citywide Nazirhat geometry coverage.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified GET/POST requests loaded the current viewer and its public JSON endpoints. Chattogram district returned only the ongoing BDS survey and two upazila records (Anwara and Banshkhali); no Fatikchhari/Nazirhat record was returned. A metadata request for an Anwara mouza succeeded but was outside Nazirhat and was not retained. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request or TLS disablement was used.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [22.6487438204526, 91.8096353514098] was preserved and never shifted; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
No Fatikchhari/Nazirhat mouza, sheet, parcel geometry, native stable parcel identity, source parcel schema or CRS was retrieved.
The current Chattogram BDS route's returned Anwara/Banshkhali list is not proof that Nazirhat lacks cadastral records; historic or alternate survey routes may exist.
No city boundary or complete city coverage was established for an open geometry service.
A timeout, map extent miss, login wall, partial endpoint response or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or other personal/sensitive fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial reviewer qualification remains pending.
